summary: Unconditional UI initialization sequence on a __thiscall object: invokes the virtual method at vtable+28 with argument 0, then the virtual method at vtable+32 with argument 1000, then UILayoutDispatchWithDataPrep(640). Returns 0.

operations.description: Dispatch the virtual method stored at obj+0x1C (vtable byte offset 28) with this and argument 0.
Dispatch the virtual method stored at obj+0x20 (vtable byte offset 32) with this and argument 1000.
Call UILayoutDispatchWithDataPrep with the width argument 640.
Return 0 after the three initialization calls complete.

unresolved: Identity of the two virtual methods (slots at vtable+28 and vtable+32) is unknown; the reset/setup interpretation is a GUESS from the argument literals 0 and 1000.
Whether 640 is a pixel width or another layout parameter is unknown.
The meaning of the return value 0 and whether callers inspect it is unknown.
Relationship between the obj and this field bases: both refer to the same __thiscall receiver; the offset-0 vtable field is the dispatch pointer.
